arxiv-1809-06333.title: Getting the tiger by the tail: Probing the turnaround radius of structures with outer halo density profiles
arxiv-1809-06333.creator: Kyriakos Grammatikos 1 , 2 \text{Kyriakos Grammatikos}^{1,2} and Vasiliki Pavlidou 2 \text{Vasiliki Pavlidou}^{2}
arxiv-1809-06333.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Kyriakos Grammatikos 1 , 2 \text{Kyriakos Grammatikos}^{1,2} and Vasiliki Pavlidou 2 \text{Vasiliki Pavlidou}^{2}. In this paper we develop a new semianalytical approach to quantifying the density profile of outer dark matter halos, motivated by the remarkable universality those profiles, for a wide range of dynamical parameters of the inner halos. We show that our minimalist model is robust under significant variations of its input parameters around the currently known values and we identify the turnaround radius as the most important scale of the problem.

arxiv-2103-03934.title: An Ensemble with Shared Representations Based on Convolutional Networks for Continually Learning Facial Expressions Thanks: All of the authors are with Knowledge Technology, Department of Informatics, University of Hamburg, Vogt-Koelln-Str. 30, 22527 Hamburg, Germany {siqueira, barros, magg, wermter
arxiv-2103-03934.creator: Henrique Siqueira, Pablo Barros, Sven Magg, Stefan Wermter
arxiv-2103-03934.description: Abstract Social robots able to continually learn facial expressions could progressively improve their emotion recognition capability towards people interacting with them. Semi-supervised learning through ensemble predictions is an efficient strategy to leverage the high exposure of unlabelled facial expressions during human-robot interactions.

arxiv-2105-13331.title: Quantization and Deployment of Deep Neural Networks on Microcontrollers
arxiv-2105-13331.creator: Pierre-Emmanuel Novac *, Ghouthi Boukli Hacene , Alain Pegatoquet , Benoît Miramond , Vincent Gripon
arxiv-2105-13331.description: Abstract Embedding Artificial Intelligence into low-power devices is a challenge that has been partly overcome with recent advances in machine learning and hardware design. Presently, deep neural networks can be deployed on embedded targets to perform different tasks such as speech recognition, object detection or human activity recognition.

arxiv-2304-09300.title: Relative Trisections of Fiber Bundles over the Circle
arxiv-2304-09300.creator: Rudy Dissler
arxiv-2304-09300.description: Abstract For an oriented 4 4 –dimensional fiber bundle over S 1 S^{1} , we build a relative trisection from a sutured Heegaard splitting of the fiber. We provide an algorithm to explicitly construct the associated relative trisection diagram, from a sutured Heegaard diagram of the fiber.

arxiv-2409-14238.title: On Rees algebras of ideals and modules with weak residual conditions
arxiv-2409-14238.creator: Alessandra Costantini, Edward F. Price III, Matthew Weaver
arxiv-2409-14238.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alessandra Costantini, Edward F. Price III, Matthew Weaver. Let E E be a module of projective dimension one over R = k ⁡ [ x 1 , … , x d ] R=k[x_{1},\ldots,x_{d}] . If E E is presented by a matrix φ \varphi with linear entries and the number of generators of E E is bounded locally up to codimension d − 1 d-1 , the Rees ring ℛ ⁡ ( E ) \mathcal{R}(E) is well understood.

arxiv-2502-16182.title: IPO: Your Language Model is Secretly a Preference Classifier
arxiv-2502-16182.creator: Shivank Garg, Ayush Singh, Shweta Singh, Paras Chopra
arxiv-2502-16182.description: Abstract 0 0 footnotetext: *Equal contribution. Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as the primary method for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences. While it enables LLMs to achieve human-level alignment, it often incurs significant computational and financial costs due to its reliance on training external reward models or human-labeled preferences.

arxiv-2505-18507.title: The Hawaii Infrared Supernova Study (HISS): Spectroscopic Data Release 1 Facilities: Keck, IRTF
arxiv-2505-18507.creator: K. Medler, C. Ashall, M. Shahbandeh, J. M. DerKacy, W. B. Hoogendam, D. O. Jones, B. J. Shappee, J. T. Hinkle, C. M. Pfeffer, E. Baron, P. Hoeflich, E. Hsiao
arxiv-2505-18507.description: Abstract We present the first data release of the Hawaii Infrared Supernova Study ( HISS ), consisting of a large sample of near-infrared (NIR) spectra, 0.7 − 2.5 0.7-2.5 µm, obtained with the Keck-II/NIRES and IRTF/SpeX spectrographs. This sample is comprised of 90 NIR spectra of 48 transient events, spanning from hours after explosion to ≥ + 350 \geq+350 days.

arxiv-2506-19279.title: EmoStage: A Framework for Accurate Empathetic Response Generation via Perspective-Taking and Phase Recognition
arxiv-2506-19279.creator: Zhiyang Qi, Keiko Takamizo, Mariko Ukiyo, Michimasa Inaba
arxiv-2506-19279.description: Abstract The rising demand for mental health care has fueled interest in AI-driven counseling systems. While large language models (LLMs) offer significant potential, current approaches face challenges, including limited understanding of clients’ psychological states and counseling stages, reliance on high-quality training data, and privacy concerns associated with commercial deployment.

arxiv-2510-24861.title: A Semi-Lagrangian Adaptive Rank (SLAR) Method for High-Dimensional Vlasov Dynamics
arxiv-2510-24861.creator: Nanyi Zheng, William A. Sands, Daniel Hayes, Andrew J. Christlieb, Jing-Mei Qiu
arxiv-2510-24861.description: Abstract Abstract. We extend our previous work on a semi-Lagrangian adaptive rank (SLAR) integrator, in the finite difference framework for nonlinear Vlasov-Poisson systems, to the general high-order tensor setting. The proposed scheme retains the high-order accuracy of semi-Lagrangian methods, ensuring stability for large time steps and avoiding dimensional splitting errors.

arxiv-2602-10886.title: The CLEF-2026 FinMMEval Lab: Multilingual and Multimodal Evaluation of Financial AI Systems
arxiv-2602-10886.creator: Zhuohan Xie, Rania Elbadry, Fan Zhang, Georgi Georgiev, Xueqing Peng, Lingfei Qian, Jimin Huang, Dimitar Dimitrov, Vanshikaa Jani, Yuyang Dai, Jiahui Geng, Yuxia Wang, Ivan Koychev, Veselin Stoyanov, Preslav Nakov

We present the setup and the tasks of the FinMMEval Lab at CLEF 2026, which introduces the first multilingual and multimodal evaluation framework for financial Large Language Models (LLMs).

pmc-10654736.title: Mechanism of strength deterioration of red sandstone on reservoir bank slopes under the action of dry–wet cycles
pmc-10654736.creator: Chao Chen, Baoyun Zhao, Liyun Zhang, Wei Huang
pmc-10654736.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). To investigate the micro-scale mechanism of strength deterioration under different times of dry–wet cycles, laboratory tests of physical properties, triaxial compression, X-ray diffraction (XRD) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) were conducted on red sandstone on reservoir bank slopes. The research results showed that when the 5th dry–wet cycle ended, the dry mass and peak strength started to rapidly decline, while the porosity and saturated mass increased rapidly. In general, all of these behaviours become relatively stable when the number of cycles increased.

pmc-10680045.title: Telerehabilitation for a Non-specific Low Back Pain: A Case Report
pmc-10680045.creator: Priti Mehendale, Madhavan Iyenagar, Geeta D Bhatt, Khyati Kothary
pmc-10680045.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). One of the most common conditions that affect activities of daily living and make them significantly more difficult to perform is low back pain (LBP). As a result, it is essential to treat LBP at an early stage. Particularly in geographically remote areas where there is a shortage of medical professionals and a lack of rehabilitation services, telerehabilitation is considered a potential alternative.

pmc-11476766.title: Functional Bidirectionality of ERV-Derived Long Non-Coding RNAs in Humans
pmc-11476766.creator: Yanmei Song, Hongling Wen, Xiuli Zhai, Lei Jia, Lin Li
pmc-11476766.description: Human endogenous retroviruses (HERVs) are widely recognized as the result of exogenous retroviruses infecting the ancestral germline, stabilizing integration and vertical transmission during human genetic evolution. To date, endogenous retroviruses (ERVs) appear to have been selected for human physiological functions with the loss of retrotransposable capabilities. ERV elements were previously regarded as junk DNA for a long time.

pmc-11531522.title: An efficient leakage power optimization framework based on reinforcement learning with graph neural network
pmc-11531522.creator: Peng Cao, Yuhan Dong, Zhanhua Zhang, Wenjie Ding, Jiahao Wang
pmc-11531522.description: Threshold voltage (Vth) assignment is convenient for leakage optimization due to the exponential relation between leakage power and Vth by swapping logic cells without routing effort. However, it poses great challenge in large scale circuit design as an NP-hard problem.

pmc-11568717.title: Anxiety and depression among various blood groups of undergraduate medical and physical therapy students
pmc-11568717.creator: Rubab-e-Hira, Muhammad Ali, Shireen Jawed, Benash Altaf
pmc-11568717.description: Objective:To access the frequency of depression and anxiety among the various blood groups of medical and physiotherapy students.Method:A cross-sectional study on 215 MBBS and DPT students was conducted at Aziz Fatimah Medical and Dental College (AFMDC) from November 2022-May 2023.

pmc-11615796.title: Chronic Exposure to Bioaerosols in PM2.5 from Garbage Stations Accelerates Vascular Aging via the NF‐κB/NLRP3 Pathway
pmc-11615796.creator: Peier Chen, Xiaodong Ning, Weijing Feng, Yajing Li, Guoqin Chen, Xu Shi, YuXuan Pan, Xueqin Shi, Yafang Xiao, Yuhua Liu, Guoxia Zhang, Feiran Zhou, Caiwen Ou
pmc-11615796.description: The fine particulate matter (PM2.5) in air pollution is a critical risk factor influencing human health. Our study included 8144 participants and showed that the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events increases by 35% (HR, 1.35; 95% CI, 1.14–1.60) for participants with the highest quartile to PM2.5 exposure as compared to those with lowest quartile.

pmc-11712138.title: Performance of a new instrument designed to assess medication use in cognitive impairment and dementia: A cross‐sectional analysis
pmc-11712138.creator: Rishabh Sharma, Linda Lee, Feng Chang, Tejal Patel
pmc-11712138.description: BackgroundThe Medication Review in Cognitive Impairment and Dementia (MedRevCiD) checklist is a new tool designed to assist health care professionals in optimizing medication use in individuals with Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) or dementia. It consists of 6 domains, each of which addresses a specific medication use issue such as medication management and adherence.

pmc-12449161.title: Treatment With Romosozumab In Progressive Pseudorheumatoid Dysplasia
pmc-12449161.creator: Nicolò Bisceglia, Emanuela Scarano, Anna Piazza, Alessandra Gambineri, Uberto Pagotto, Guido Zavatta
pmc-12449161.description: Progressive pseudorheumatoid dysplasia (PPD) is a rare genetic disorder caused by pathogenic variants in Wnt1-inducible signaling pathway protein 3 gene. The primary skeletal issues include progressive joint stiffness, bone deformities, and bone fragility. Patients with PPD may have a higher risk of fractures resulting from secondary osteoporosis, joint instability, and skeletal weakness.

pmc-12544730.title: Development and Application of an Algorithm for Statin‐Induced Myopathy Based on Electronic Health Record‐Derived Structured Elements
pmc-12544730.creator: Akinyemi Oni‐Orisan, Meng Lu, Jonathan A Peng, Ronald M Krauss, Carlos Iribarren, Marisa W Medina
pmc-12544730.description: PurposeConsidering the non‐specific nature of muscle symptoms, studies of statin‐induced myopathy (SIM) in electronic health records require accurate algorithms that can reliably identify true statin‐causing cases. Prior algorithms were constructed in study populations that preclude broad applicability.MethodsUsing only structured data elements of electronic health records, we developed a two‐step algorithm to identify true SIM cases.

pmc-12750759.title: Effectiveness of education programme to increase competency of health cadres in Indonesia: a cluster non-randomised controlled trial
pmc-12750759.creator: Dewie Sulistyorini, K A T M Ehsanul Huq, Abdulfatai Olamilekan Babaita, Sadia A Aivey, Gao Huiying, Kana Kazawa, Yasuko Fukushima, Mayumi Kako, Michiko Moriyama
pmc-12750759.description: ObjectivesHealth cadres, who assist midwives in supporting pregnant women in community settings, need to enhance their competencies in identifying risk factors and referring high-risk pregnant women to midwives for further care. Since the capabilities of these health cadres are influenced by maternal complications, an educational programme was implemented to strengthen their skills.

pmc-13245056.title: Investigating the gut microbiota in advanced heart failure and cardiac cachexia
pmc-13245056.creator: Mansimran Singh Dulay, Despoina Chrysostomou, Monica Campos, Marko Storch, Lauren A Roberts, Damanpreet Singh Dev, Nahal Raza, Ramey Assaf, Tricia Tan, Michael Marber, Rakesh Sharma, Thomas Lüscher, Julian R Marchesi, Owais Dar
pmc-13245056.description: Cardiac cachexia (CC) is associated with advanced heart failure (AHF), characterized by unintentional weight loss (UWL) of fat/muscle. It is exacerbated by right ventricular systolic dysfunction (RVSD). The potential pathogenic role of gut microbiota (GM) changes has not been investigated in CC. We aimed to explore this.

pmc-13442860.title: Evaluation of triumeq treatment on a TDP-43 mouse model of amyotrophic Lateral sclerosis
pmc-13442860.creator: Megan Fowler, Jillian M Carr, Julian Gold, Adam Walker, Mary-Louise Rogers
pmc-13442860.description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterised by the accumulation of TAR DNA Binding Protein (43 kDa; TDP-43) within the cytoplasm of neurons. Endogenous retroviruses (ERVs) have been implicated in ALS pathology and the application of antiretroviral therapy, specifically Triumeq, has been proposed for treatment of ALS.

pmc-13628682.title: Digital Analysis of Occlusal Contacts in Angle Class II and Class III Malocclusion
pmc-13628682.creator: Irena Bogatinovska, Irena Gavrilovikj
pmc-13628682.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the number, interocclusal distance categories, and spatial distribution of occlusal contacts per subject in Angle Class II and Class III malocclusions using digital intraoral models.Materials and MethodsThis exploratory, cross-sectional study evaluated 60 untreated subjects (30 Class II, 30 Class III).
